rule: Every blocker is mandatory. CERTIFICATE=READY is admissible only when every blocker is CLEARED with cited evidence and every gate of every core component is PASS.

blockers.title: GitHub Actions hosted jobs are billing-locked for the owner account

Latest confirmations: Middleware run 36077007432 (2026-09-25T00:19Z), Kong run 36076814183 (00:17Z), Keycloak run 36076125140 (00:08Z), Odoo run 36074949076 (2026-09-24T23:53Z). The lock is recorded since 2026-09-17. It left the main-push validation of Caddy 0feae8a and Odoo c1fb759a unexecuted, and the Middleware release run 35613442378 on 0606b0d never started. Only the self-hosted runner codestra-ubuntu-middleware executes jobs.

blockers.title: No live Caddy -> Kong -> Middleware:8095 identity/route matrix at an exact digest
blockers.observed: The source contract is consistent. deploy/public-api-route-contract.json has canonical sha256 9c32daecd4a15104c6f9ff60ce19c8f7e78707fb31d9fd9fcb55b1b8dfa3512b, equal to the .sha256 pin and to the hashes pinned in Kong config/kong-canonical-middleware-routes.json, the Caddy config/caddy-kong-contract.v1.json and the Keycloak middleware-api-access.v3.json. It lists 117 operations: 105 shared_edge to middleware-integration-api:8095, 10 denied and 2 private_only to odoo:8069. The Middleware verifier pins the issuer per environment, requires the JWKS URL to equal <issuer>/protocol/openid-connect/certs, and enforces aud=middleware-api, RS256, an azp allowlist and a lifetime of 300 s or less. No live matrix has been run through the edge (valid, expired, wrong-issuer, wrong-aud, wrong-azp and wrong-scope tokens per route class). The PAS-47 edge and PAS-64 route certification work is still on open PRs (#312, #314), not on main.
blockers.clear_condition: In staging at the exact digests, run the edge identity/route matrix through Caddy and Kong to Middleware:8095. Record per-route-class status codes and the rejecting layer, with no token material in the report, bound to the six main SHAs.

blockers.title: Production Kong drifts from main and has not been read back since 2026-09-06
blockers.observed: Main config/kong-middleware-routes.production.yml defines 1 service (middleware-integration-api:8095, http) with 105 routes on api.codestra.co. Every route has openid-connect (issuer https://auth.codestra.co/realms/codestra discovery; audience middleware-api on 103 routes and codestra-callback-api on 2), post-function header scrub, correlation-id, rate-limiting and request-size-limiting, and 10 request-termination denials. The only live readback, PRODUCTION_ROUTE_READBACK_20260906.json (29 routes, 2026-09-06), shows other upstreams: codestra-middleware-integration-api-1, appolon-middleware-integration-api and several auth adapters. The readback is not bound to a SHA. Open PR #115 changes the Middleware route files.
blockers.clear_condition: Deploy the main route set to staging, then production, and record a sanitized Admin API readback whose route hash equals main. Resolve PR #115 first.

blockers.title: Caddy transitional bypass handlers forward identity headers unscrubbed
blockers.observed: In sites/api.codestra.co.caddy, the Kong-bound handlers proxy to {$CADDY_KONG_UPSTREAM} and delete 23 client-supplied identity headers (X-User-ID, X-Authenticated-*, X-Codestra-*, X-Consumer-*, X-Admin and others). Two handlers skip that scrub: @realtime (/ws/agent, /api/v1/realtime/sessions, /healthz, /readyz, /version) to {$CADDY_REALTIME_UPSTREAM}, and the catch-all handle to {$CADDY_LEGACY_API_UPSTREAM}. No route goes directly to Middleware:8095, which is correct. Open PRs #186 and #181 change this site and the Caddy-Kong contract.
blockers.clear_condition: Remove the transitional fallbacks or apply the same identity-header scrub to them. Resolve PRs #186 and #181 on main, and prove the behaviour in the staging edge matrix.
